about_the_game:
This is a loot-driven game where you customize your hero through items and talents.

Find and equip powerful gear to enhance your abilities and unlock devastating combos.

Seize control of the map by destroying and converting enemy structures to generate income.

Level up your hero, hunt for legendary items, and shape your build through a flexible talent system.

Face off against bosses and survive endless waves of enemies.

Choose from a diverse roster of heroes, each with their own unique playstyle, whether it’s charging in as a melee brawler, casting destructive spells as a mage, or constructing defenses as a builder hero.

The objective is simple: destroy the Rift to win. If your core falls, you lose.

This game blends the best of ARPG and MOBA genres; loot, lane pushing, hero progression, and base defense, all in one.

Your levels and loot persist between games, making you stronger every time you play.

The Lore: 📜
Eredian was once a mage who could walk between worlds. But in his search for forbidden knowledge, he opened a portal to Hell itself. What he found there twisted his spirit and granted him dark power. Cast out, he now tears open rifts across the cosmos, desperate to return—shattering planets, collapsing suns, and leaving entire worlds scarred by his madness.

You are one of the heroes who must rise against him. The fate of the universe rests on your courage to stand against Eredian before his obsession consumes all creation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None

short_description: Loot-driven PvE action RPG where you push lanes, collect items, fight bosses, customize your hero and survive endless waves. Fight your way to victory and put an end to Eredian's chaos once and for all.
